objective: Measure whether an external memory configuration preserves checked i64 semantics during later arithmetic refactoring.
task: Study S3 i64 arithmetic in one session, then in a later session optimize or refactor the numeric path without introducing silent wraparound or weakening deterministic failure cases.

critical_invariants.description: S3 i64 overflow is checked and must not silently wrap.
Division by zero and INT64_MIN / -1 remain deterministic failures.
